lines.text: Every seven years creditors must cancel what a brother owes, though they may collect from a foreigner.
If they obey the LORD, He will bless them so that they lend to many nations but borrow from none.
A man must open his hand to a poor brother and give without a grieving heart, and the LORD will test him.
A fellow Hebrew who served six years must be freed in the seventh, remembering they were slaves in Babylon.
A servant who loves the household and is well off with his master has his ear pierced with an awl and serves for life.
